Public chart placeholders

This public article explains a news dataset in enough detail to be retained by the article reader. The original publisher includes several charts as placeholder elements, rather than as iframe elements, so the parser must preserve their explicit identifiers without executing their scripts.

Each chart is still loaded only when the reader asks to view it. The source does not need a site-specific rule and no JavaScript from the publisher is required to identify a publicly declared visualisation.

Unsupported declarations must remain ordinary article content, without being converted into local chart requests. This includes stories, custom hosts and malformed identifiers, even if they superficially resemble a supported component.
